description: This is a unit test class for the JsonCharEscaper class within the org.eclipse.ditto.json package. It contains various test cases verifying the correct escaping of special characters in JSON strings, including control characters, quotes, and backslashes, following RFC 8259 guidelines.

classes.name: JsonCharEscaperTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class testing the functionality of JsonCharEscaper, particularly its ability to escape special characters in JSON strings according to RFC 8259.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the JsonCharEscaper instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the JsonCharEscaper instance is immutable.

methods.name: doNotEscapeNormalCharactersBeforeBackslash
methods.description: Checks that normal characters (excluding quote and backslash) do not get escaped.

methods.name: escapeQuote
methods.description: Verifies that a quote character is properly escaped.

methods.name: escapeReverseSolidus
methods.description: Verifies that a backslash is properly escaped.

methods.name: escapeControlCharactersWithoutShorthands
methods.description: Ensures control characters (except shorthand ones) are escaped as unicode sequences.

methods.name: escapeControlCharactersWithShorthands
methods.description: Confirms that control characters with shorthands are escaped to their shorthand notation.

methods.name: minimalJsonString
methods.description: Tests that a raw string is correctly converted to its JSON string representation.
